method_note: IFAC World Congress 2026 (Busan, Aug 23-28, 2026): the congress is complete and its full program is published, so it was used instead of the 2023 Yokohama fallback. Counted 419 oral technical sessions (233 Regular + 131 Open Invited Track + 55 Invited; 2440 papers) from the ifac-sms.org (PaperCept) program, grouping numbered series and stripping "LB:"/"JO-xxx:"/"Dissemination:" prefixes. Excluded: 29 interactive/shotgun and poster sessions (1152 papers, broad titles), tutorials, forums, special/demo sessions, plenaries and semi-plenaries. Application-domain sessions whose titles stress control/optimization (e.g. power systems, automotive powertrain) were mapped to control-theory because the taxonomy has no energy, biomedical-systems or process-control keyword; sessions without a control/robotics/AI anchor were left unmapped. Mapping of the 356 distinct titles used keyword rules plus manual overrides. Each session split equally across at most 2 keywords; weight = sessions mapped / 388. 31 session(s) had no taxonomy equivalent and were left out of the denominator: FDI and FTC Strategies for Offshore Renewable Energy Applications; Engineering Diabetes Technologies (3); Digital Technologies for Healthy Ageing and Social Inclusion; Challenges in Synthetic Biology; Digital Twins: From Sensors (Zero) to Systems to Clinical Outcomes (Hero); Technology-Supported Mobility, Care, and Well-Being across the Lifespan; Challenges in Computational Systems Biology; Supporting Ageing Populations: Care Transitions, Urban Design, and Digital Infrastructure; Statistical Inference; Energy Storage Systems; Challenges in Microalgae Production Processes; Optimal Operation of Smart Multi-Energy Microgrids; Solar Power and Wind Energy Systems; Biomedical and Environment Systems; Biosystems and Bioprocesses (2); Energy Systems, Natural Resources and Environmental Management; Decentralized Economic Models and Systems; Advanced Methods for Active Distribution Networks under Smart Grids; Digital Twins and Diagnostics of the Human Cardiovascular System; Recent Progress in Mean-Field Game Theory and Applications; Time Series Modeling; Smart Cities, Urban Systems, and Social Infrastructure; Real-Time Operations in Transportation; Robotics; Modeling and Diagnostics of the Respiratory System (2); A Key for Sustainable Longevity: Integrating Physical Asset Management and Obsolescence Management; Healthcare Management, Disease Control, Critical Care. Keywords below 0.02 omitted; listed weights sum to 0.872.
